svg.desc: регулирующий клапан для работы с ТПТС 1718 плюс TXS

rt:var.name: pv_OU
rt:var.comment: указатель на переменную управления, которая может встретиться для любого объекта

rt:model.rt:sub: Sub Show_A() If pv_A != Nothing Then If pv_A.Quality != PLS_QUAL_BAD Then If pv_A.Value != 0 Then g_indic_A.fill = Color_A Else g_indic_A.fill = "Col_Grey5" End If g_indic_A.fill_opacity = 0.35 Else g_indic_A.fill = Color_Inval g_indic_A.fill_opacity = 1 End If Else g_indic_A.fill = Color_ErLink g_indic_A.fill_opacity = 1 End If End Sub

Sub Show_H() If pv_H != Nothing Then If pv_H.Quality != PLS_QUAL_BAD Then If pv_H.Value != 0 Then g_indic_H.fill = Color_H Else g_indic_H.fill = "Col_Grey5" End If g_indic_H.fill_opacity = 0.35 Else g_indic_H.fill = Color_Inval g_indic_H.fill_opacity = 1 End If Else g_indic_H.fill = Color_ErLink g_indic_H.fill_opacity = 1 End If End Sub

Sub Show_F() If pv_Fail != Nothing Then If pv_Fail.Quality != PLS_QUAL_BAD Then If pv_Fail.Value != 0 Then g_Al_frame.visibility = "visible" Else g_Al_frame.visibility = "hidden" End If Else g_Al_frame.visibility = "hidden" End If Else g_Al_frame.visibility = "hidden" End If End Sub

Sub Get_Open_State() If STrig Then g_body_l.fill = Color_Remont g_body_r.fill = Color_Remont ElseIf (pv_Z0 != Nothing) Then If (pv_Z0.Quality == PLS_QUAL_BAD) Then g_body_l.fill = Color_Inval g_body_r.fill = Color_Inval ElseIf (pv_Z0.Value & 3) == 2 Then g_body_l.fill = Color_OPEN_M g_body_r.fill = Color_OPEN_M ElseIf (pv_Z0.Value & 3) == 1 Then g_body_l.fill = Color_CLOSE_M g_body_r.fill = Color_CLOSE_M ElseIf (pv_Z0.Value & 3) == 0 Then g_body_l.fill = Color_CLOSE_M g_body_r.fill = Color_OPEN_M Else g_body_l.fill = Color_Inval g_body_r.fill = Color_Inval End If End If End Sub

Sub Show_Pos() If pv_Pos != Nothing Then Dim Pos As Double Pos = pv_Pos.Value g_Position_bg.visibility = "visible" g_Position_val.visibility = "visible" If Pos <= 1 Then Pos = 1 ElseIf Pos > 100 Then Pos = 100 End If g_Position_val.x2 = -25.0 + Pos / 2 Else g_Position_bg.visibility = "hidden" g_Position_val.visibility = "hidden" End If End Sub
rt:model.rt:event: g.transform="" g_InGr.visibility = "hidden" If (KKS_ERL == "NULL") && (PID_Auto == "NULL") && (PID_Dist == "NULL") Then g.transform = "scale(0.75 0.75 0 0)" g_body_l.fill = Color_Static g_body_r.fill = Color_Static g_bg_1.visibility = "hidden" g_bg_2.visibility = "hidden" g_indic_H.visibility = "hidden" g_indic_A.visibility = "hidden" g_Position_bg.visibility = "hidden" g_Position_val.visibility = "hidden" g_Al_frame.visibility = "hidden" End If If (KKS_ERL != "NULL") Then If requests_allown Then pv_Z0 = BIN(KKS_ERL + "_Z0") End If pv_F1 = BIN(KKS_ERL + "_F1") pv_OU = BIN(KKS_ERL + "_OU") End If If pv_Z0 == Nothing Then g_body_l.fill = "Col_Grey2" g_body_r.fill = "Col_Grey2" End If If (PID_Auto != "NULL") Then pv_A = BIN(PID_Auto) End If If (PID_Dist != "NULL") Then pv_H = BIN(PID_Dist) End If If (PID_Fail != "NULL") Then pv_Fail = BIN(PID_Fail) Else g_Al_frame.visibility = "hidden" End If If (PID_Position != "NULL") Then pv_Pos = ANA(PID_Position) End If If (PID_Deviation != "NULL") Then pv_Dev = ANA(PID_Deviation) End If If (PID_Setpoint != "NULL") Then pv_SP = ANA(PID_Setpoint) End If

PID_Dist = "" + PID_Dist + """, 0) ElseIf pv_Fail == Nothing Then ShowWarning ("Ошибка привязки.

PID_Position = "" + PID_Position + """, 0) ElseIf pv_Dev == Nothing Then ShowWarning ("Ошибка привязки.
PID_Deviation = "" + PID_Deviation + """, 0) ElseIf pv_SP == Nothing Then ShowWarning ("Ошибка привязки.
PID_Setpoint = "" + PID_Setpoint + """, 0) ElseIf pv_OU != Nothing Then //KKS_ERL|PID_CV|PID_DV|PID_SP|PID_H|PID_A|PID_Fail Open_ws_wf_wi("TXS_ERL_Reg_valve", KKS_ERL + "|" + PID_Position + "|" + PID_Deviation + "|" + PID_Setpoint + "|" + PID_Dist + "|" + PID_Auto + "|" + PID_Fail, Operate) Else NoLink(KKS_ERL) End If
